code.description: From the closed set in spec/reason-codes.md.

message.description: Byte-stable: the matched rule's reason verbatim, or the fixed text in spec/reason-codes.md. Never interpolated data.

matched_rule.description: The rule that evaluated true. Absent when no rule matched or the walk stopped on an unsettled rule.

trace.description: Ordered rule evaluation trace for replay comparison. One "<ordinal>:<rule_id>:<true|false|unsettled>" entry per rule evaluated; see spec/reason-codes.md.
